scope: Current product-path public C API discovery, solve, compilation, exact evaluation, and Simulator verification
historical_fixture_policy: Additive current-product coverage only. Do not modify the historical solver-regressions/s8.4r/v1 fixture or evidence.

selection.carrier: positive-weight natural prefix family with the lowest total live-pool weight
selection.intermediate_target: positive-weight natural suffix family with the highest total live-pool weight after adding the carrier
selection.purpose: Make preservation of the legal magic carrier valuable while keeping the Imprint retry simulation bounded.

goal.registry_contract: action_mode goal_relevant keeps automatic assembly on the normal bounded product registry; the explicit primitive envelope limits this focused forced-winner solve to the Imprint attempt and continuation actions

forced_winner_overrides.reason: Force the eligible Imprint retry to beat the otherwise selected Eldritch Chaos retry route while preserving every Bestiary component and primitive continuation price.
Force the eligible Imprint retry to beat the alternate Eldritch Annul retry route exposed after pricing out Eldritch Chaos.

economy.override_disclosure: Only two non-Bestiary retry inputs are overridden: Eldritch Chaos Orb from the checked-in 39.21-chaos quote to 1000 chaos and Eldritch Orb of Annulment from 40.53 chaos to 1000 chaos. Craicic Croaker remains the 66-chaos quote, each generic rare beast remains the overridable 1-chaos owner default, and all primitive continuation prices retain their snapshot quotes.
